offered_action_specs.name: rollback_deploy
offered_action_specs.description: Roll one service back to the settings it ran before its latest deploy, as the deploy log records them. Code plans it from that log, not from your tools' results, so you can name it even when they cannot see deploys: if the log holds no deploy of that service to undo, or the service changed since, code refuses it. Its container is recreated, so the service pauses while it restarts. Money already booked wrong stays wrong: a rollback stops new damage, and repairs nothing.

evidence.shows: money_check failed two invariants. Seven events were posted 2 or 3 times, and the ledger is +$461.00 against the provider. The ledger is balanced, and payments and refunds match the provider, so the damage is confined to duplicate ledger postings.
webhook-receiver queued evt_000251 twice, at offsets 73 and 76 on partition 2, about 0.5s apart. The same event was on Kafka twice.
ledger-consumer posted evt_000251 from both offsets (2-73 at 01:29:37.009 and 2-76 at 01:29:37.685), with no already-processed skip. The second posting came after the consumer restart.

Up to 01:29:34 the consumer logged 'already processed' for duplicates. It then stopped, was revoked and restarted at 01:29:37 with 'ledger consumer starting' mode=naive. No 'already processed' lines appear after the restart in the lines returned.
Ledger outcomes are 466 posted and 14 already_processed, so dedupe worked for some duplicates before the change. payment-confirmer deduplicated its repeats (already_confirmed 428).
recent_deploys failed (docker did not answer), so the deploy and its settings are unconfirmed. c5 failed the same way.

proposed_fix.summary: Roll ledger-consumer back to the settings it ran before its latest deploy, so it deduplicates by event_id again. Afterwards, repair the duplicate ledger postings with a reviewed data repair. Transactions 255, 266, 272, 273 and 297 are known extra postings, and evt_000308 has two extra ones. Also check for extra postings beyond the 7 findings. The rollback stops new damage and repairs nothing already booked.
